name: ibmi-mcp
description: Give your AI agent terminal, file transfer, and SQL access to IBM i systems
long_description: ibmi-mcp lets AI agents like Claude interact with IBM i through 5250 terminal emulation, SFTP file transfer, and SQL queries. It provides full TN5250 emulation with auto-signon, function key support, local editing, structured screen data, configurable EBCDIC codepage translation, IFS file transfer via SFTP, and SQL access via ODBC.
